source_text: 四级 2020 年-12月51 鱼是春节前夕餐桌上不可或缺的一道菜,因为汉语中“鱼”字的发音与“余”字的发音相同。正由于这 个象征性的意义,春节期间鱼也作为礼物送给亲戚朋友。 鱼的象征意义据说源于中国传统文化。 中国人 有节省的传统,他们认为节省得愈多,就感到愈为安全。今天,尽管人们愈来愈富裕了,但他们仍然认为节 省是一种值得弘扬的美德。 四级2020年12月
reference_translation: Fish is an indispensable dish on the dinner table on the eve of the Spring Festival because the pronunciation of the Chinese character "鱼" (fish) is the same as that of "余" (surplus). Due to this symbolic meaning, fish is also given as a gift to relatives and friends during the Spring Festival. The symbolic meaning of fish is said to originate from traditional Chinese culture. Chinese people have a tradition of being thrifty. They believe that the more they save, the safer they will feel. Today, although people are becoming wealthier, they still regard thrift as a virtue worthy of promotion.
